pr_title: GameEngine: harden ADR0155 WSL CUDA setup
pr_body:
## Summary

Hardens the ADR0155 WSL2 managed llama.cpp path after representative-machine setup exposed POSIX shell and CUDA-runtime relocation risks.

- replaces fragile numeric package-count shell logic with exact per-package dpkg status checks
- adds CUDA 12.4 install RPATH plus $ORIGIN and verifies staged binaries after source deletion
- removes the `{ ... } || ...` pattern that can suppress POSIX `set -e` failures and tails the build log through an EXIT trap instead
- stages GGUF transfers under a temporary WSL path, verifies SHA-256, then atomically renames into the final model location
- adds focused regression coverage for the WSL shell/build contract

Windows-native setup is unchanged. Visual Validation is not required because no UI layout/rendering behavior changes.
